REPORT

Subject (in full) Shanghai Daily News in re "Mme. Fang Yi Tze"

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. J.W. Prince.

Sir,

Madame Fang Yi Tze (方治夫人) is at present residing in Nanking, where she is employed, and it is scarcely probable that she would come to Shanghai simply as a witness in the case, should action be taken against "The Shanghai Daily News" in respect of publication of the article referred to in the attached.

I am informed that Madame Fang Yi Tze (方治夫人) is a Japanese by birth, and that she was married to her husband, who is Chinese, while he was a student in Japan.

J W Prince
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Supt. Ian,
Please ascertain if Madam Fang would be willing to come to Shanghai.
（签名）

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince.
Sir,
The mosquito newspaper entitled Shanghai Siao Jih
Pao 小日報 (Petty News) is one of the leading papers of its
kind in Shanghai. It is a daily issue the publication of which
was begun on August 6, 1926. The Editorial Office of the
paper is at No. 12 Henry Fong (亨利坊), Rue Paul Henry, and its
Editor is one Yeu Pan Kwang (尤半狂). The distribution
office of the paper is at No. 279 Shantung Road from which
some 10,000 copies of the paper are issued daily. This paper
is registered with the Central District Kuomintang and the
Ministry of Industry. The article regarding "Madame Fang Chih",
referred to in the attached Despatch from the Public Safety
Bureau, was forwarded in our afternoon translations of December
19. Please see copy attached.
The Shanghai Daily News 上海日報 is edited by one
Kan Lai Sun (干蘭蓀), at No. 46 Ching Woo Fong (清和坊),
Chekiang Road. This is one of the smaller papers with a
circulation of some 2,500 copies daily. The action against
these papers, as suggested by the Chief of the Public Safety
Bureau, can only be taken through the medium of the Court on
a specific charge laid by the complainants.
C. D. I.
O/C Special Branch.

先生，
名为《上海小日报》（Petty News）的小报是上海此类报纸中的主要刊物之一。该报为日报，于1926年8月6日开始出版。该报编辑部位于保罗·亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）亨利坊12号，编辑为尤半狂。该报发行处位于山东路279号，每日发行量约10,000份。该报已在中央区国民党党部及实业部注册。关于“方治夫人”的文章，即公安局公函中提及者，已收录于我方12月19日的下午译文中。请参阅附件副本。
《上海日报》由干兰蓀编辑，地址为浙江路清和坊46号。这是一份较小的报纸，日发行量约2,500份。正如公安局局长所建议，对这些报纸采取行动只能通过法院进行，需由控告人提出具体指控。
C. D. I.
特科主管。

January 10, 1933. Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS.

The following article appears in the
Shanghai Jih Pao, a mosquito paper dated December 19, 1932:-

RECOLLECTION OF MRS. FANG CHIH

Fang Chih(方治), the secretary of the
Central Propaganda Committee and concurrently member of
the Committee of the Central Compilation Committee,
formerly studied in Japan. During his stay in Japan,
he fell in love with a Japanese sing song prostitute
named Kiyokawa. After Fang's graduation, this prostitute
followed Fang to China and a formal wedding was solemnized.
The prostitute then changed her name to Fang Yi Tze(方益之).
This couple live in the vicinity of the Drum Tower, Nanking.
A reporter of this paper once met her in the Drum Tower
Park where he saw her in Chinese dress and leather shoes
just like a proper Chinese lady.
Since the outbreak of the September 13 Incident,
Fang Yi Tze has hated the arrogance and perversity of
the militarists of her mother country, so she asked her
husband to find her work in the Central Radio Broadcasting
Station. There she has been broadcasting in Japanese
severely criticising Japan and urging the Japanese mass
to rise and resist the atrocious Japanese military
movement in China in order to avert the downfall of the
two countries. This propaganda work aroused the anger
of the Japanese Government which sent a telegram instructing
Ynemura, Japanese consul at Nanking, to approach the
Chinese authorities and to demand a cessation of the
propaganda in order to avoid misunderstanding. At the
same time, the Japanese Government attacked Fang Yi Tze
as a Japanese traitor working for China at a pay of $900
a month.
Fang Yi Tze and her husband gave a reception
some time ago to Chinese and foreign pressmen at Nanking.
During the function, Fang Yi Tze stated that
she entered the Central Broadcasting service at her own
desire and out of sincerity. She denied that the Chinese
Government was paying her a single cent.
Among the persons present, were the reporters
of the Tokyo Asahi who urged Fan Yi Tze to give some
consideration to her mother country and not to conduct
evil propaganda against Japan. The suggestion was
strongly rejected.
Fang Yi Tze told her guests that she had
heard that the Japanese Government will establish a big
radio station in the Japanese Consulate at Nanking with
the intention of oppressing the Chinese Central Broadcasting
Station. "If this is true", she said, "I will petition
the Central Government to appropriate funds to build a
more powerful station".

1933年1月10日。下午译文

杂项。

以下文章刊登于1932年12月19日的一份小报《上海日报》上：-

忆方治夫人

方治，中央宣传部秘书兼中央编纂委员会委员，曾留学日本。在日本期间，他爱上了一位名叫清川（Kiyokawa）的日本妓女。方治毕业后，这名妓女随方治来到中国，并举行了正式婚礼。随后该妓女改名为方益之。这对夫妇居住在南京鼓楼附近。本报记者曾在鼓楼公园遇见她，见她身着中式服装和皮鞋，俨然一位端庄的中国女士。
自九一三事变爆发以来，方益之憎恨其祖国军阀的傲慢与乖张，因此请求丈夫在中央广播电台为她谋得一份工作。在那里，她用日语进行广播，严厉批评日本，并敦促日本民众起来抵抗日本军队在中国的暴行，以避免两国的覆灭。这种宣传工作激怒了日本政府，日本政府致电驻南京日本领事 Ynemura（音译），要求其接触中国当局，要求停止宣传，以免产生误解。同时，日本政府攻击方益之为替中国工作的日本叛徒，月薪900元。
不久前，方益之及其丈夫在南京招待了中外记者。在活动期间，方益之表示，她进入中央广播服务部门是出于自愿和诚意。她否认中国政府支付了她一分钱。
在场人士中包括《东京朝日新闻》的记者，他们敦促方益之考虑到她的祖国，不要进行反日的恶意宣传。这一建议遭到强烈拒绝。
方益之告诉客人，她听说日本政府将在南京日本领事馆建立一个大功率电台，意图压制中国中央广播电台。“如果这是真的”，她说，“我将 petition（请愿/申请）中央政府拨款建设一个更强大的电台”。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P.
& S. B. REGIST.
D4396
10/1 1938

OFFICIAL DISPATCH FROM THE BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY.

To the Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

This Bureau has received an order from the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai stating that the
Municipality has received a secret letter from the
Propaganda Section of the Central Executive Committee to
the effect that the Shanghai Siao Jih Pao (corner of Hankow
Road and Yunnan Road) always fabricates rumours and challenges
the reports of the Central Affairs Department. Its action
serves to puzzle the people. The Mayor of the Municipality
was requested to suspend the newspaper for at least one month.

The Shanghai Daily News (46 Ching Ho Fang,
Canton Road.) recently published careless reports. For
instance, on December 19, it contained an article entitled
"A remembrance of Madame Fang Chih," which was an entirely
absurd report, and might be regarded as propaganda for the
Japanese. As Mrs. Fan Chi or Madame Fang Yi Tse is in the
service of the Central Radio Broadcasting Station to undertake
broadcasting in the Japanese language, she must not be
insulted as she is serving the Kuomintang and the country
faithfully. The Mayor was also requested to impose severe
punishment, such as one month's suspension of publication
of the newspaper.

The Municipality of Greater Shanghai has referred
the matter to all bureaus and officially submit these secret letters
to your Police Department requesting you to take action, as
the above-mentioned newspapers are all located in the
Settlement.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
& 公安局登记处
D4396
1938年1月10日

公安局公函。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长，

本局接到大上海市政府命令，称市政府收到中央执行委员会宣传科的密函，内称《上海小日报》（汉口路与云南路转角）一贯制造谣言，挑战中央事务部门的报道。其行为旨在迷惑民众。已请求市政府市长责令该报停刊至少一个月。

《上海日报》（广东路清和坊46号）近期发布不实报道。例如，12月19日，该报刊登了一篇题为《忆方治夫人》的文章，纯属荒谬，可被视为亲日宣传。鉴于范智（Fan Chi）夫人或方益之夫人在中央广播电台服务，从事日语广播工作，她忠诚服务于国民党及国家，不得对其加以侮辱。亦曾请求市长予以严厉惩罚，如责令该报停刊一个月。

大上海市政府已将此事转交各局，并将上述密函正式提交贵警务处，请求你们采取行动，因为上述报纸均位于租界内。
